links.outcome: Top-1 diagnostic F1 of AI versus human experts and ChatGPT 4.0 on real-world EHRs
links.effect: In real-world testing LungDiag outperformed human experts and ChatGPT 4.0, achieving an F1 score of 0.651 for top 1 diagnosis.
links.quote: In real-world testing, LungDiag outperformed both human experts and ChatGPT 4.0, achieving an F1 score of 0.651 for top 1 diagnosis.

screen.reason: The study develops and validates LungDiag, an NLP-based EHR diagnostic system, comparing its performance to clinicians and ChatGPT-4. It evaluates model accuracy rather than testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
